title: Why your data is worth more than your salary

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: What if your data could generate more wealth than your lifetime earnings? How does that reshape our future?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Today, algorithms monetize user data through targeted ads, predictive analytics, and personalized services — often without direct compensation.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: This creates inequality, as data becomes a new form of capital controlled by a few, leaving individuals with little power or reward.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Engineers are building decentralized data marketplaces, like blockchain-based platforms, where users can sell data directly and retain control.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: Imagine a world where individuals profit from their data, enabling fairer economic models and empowering personal agency in the digital economy.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future will be shaped by those who balance innovation with equity, ensuring data’s value benefits everyone, not just a privileged few.

video_cue: A person using a transparent data dashboard to monitor and sell personal data securely to multiple companies.
